title: GovernanceAmendment
description: Machine-readable amendment procedure for the post-CONSTITUTION-strike doctrinal substrate. Migrated from docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Amendments during the 2026-05-15 CONSTITUTION strike. This file governs amendments to decision-principles.json, forbidden-operations.json, decision-rights.json, and itself.

_meta.applies_to: any PR that modifies the doctrinal substrate (see scope.applies_to)
_meta.purpose: Canonical amendment procedure. Constitutional-drift is the highest-severity defect class; this procedure ensures every doctrinal change is ratified, audited, and ledgered.

procedure.description: Open a draft amendment as a PR against the target spec file in specs/.
procedure.evidence_required: PR exists; PR draft flag set

procedure.description: PR body cites the failure mode (link to docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md row) or strategic shift (link to docs/MASTERPLAN.md section) the amendment addresses.
procedure.evidence_required: PR body contains valid MFL row link OR MASTERPLAN section link

procedure.description: At least 2 council-architecture members sign the PR body's `## Ratification` section.
procedure.evidence_required: PR body `## Ratification` section contains >=2 council-architecture GitHub handles

procedure.description: On merge, emit EVT-DOCTRINE-AMENDED (previously EVT-CONSTITUTION-AMENDED prior to 2026-05-15 strike) to the audit chain with payload {spec_id, version_before, version_after, ratifier_handles, merge_commit_sha}.
procedure.evidence_required: audit-chain shard contains EVT-DOCTRINE-AMENDED row matching the merge SHA

procedure.description: Append a row to docs/CHANGELOG.md describing the amendment and bumping the `_meta.version` of the amended spec.
procedure.evidence_required: docs/CHANGELOG.md diff includes amendment row; spec's _meta.version incremented per semver (minor for additive; major for breaking)

procedure.description: Re-walk the amended substrate against every tier-one doc within one wave; resolve any contradictions by amending the lower doc, not the substrate.
procedure.evidence_required: PR-traceability lane verdict shows all tier-one docs were inspected

drift_severity.rationale: Doctrinal drift (formerly 'constitutional drift') compounds across every PR that follows. A miss is a regression in every downstream decision.

mechanical_components.verifies: PR cannot merge without `## Ratification` section signed by >=2 council-architecture handles for amendments touching scope.applies_to paths

enforcement.gap: PR-merge-gate lane needs an amendment-recognizer that triggers on diffs touching scope.applies_to files. Candidate fitness-lane work.
